subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**meticulously**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage is emphasizing the importance of carefully verifying the credibility of sources before accepting and sharing information.
 
• The appropriate adverb should suggest thoroughness and attention to detail.
 
• "**Meticulously**" (बारीकी से) fits well because it means carefully and precisely, indicating that users should do a thorough and careful assessment of the credibility of sources.
